boundary: IEC condenser water box inlet/outlet flanges; EPC CW piping (GRP), expansion joints, counter-flanges and bolts.
connection: EN 1092-1 PN6 flanges, rubber-lined water boxes
contractor_side: IEC: condenser water box flanges (2 inlets, 2 outlets)
isolation: EPC butterfly valves per inlet and outlet half (condenser half-side operation).
location_text: condenser water box flanges (2 inlets, 2 outlets)
